title: Astro 7 upgrade and the load-time refactor
description: Stay on Astro and fix what actually hurts. Two committed pieces: move the engine from Astro 5.17.1 to 7.2.0 (Vite 8, Node 22.12 floor), and fix the index loader that renders 861 tracker bodies to build a table of titles — the measured cause of a 3.2 s first request that grows linearly with the corpus. A third tier of audit-found defects is candidate scope, not yet agreed. Scoped by the runtime-stack-migration audit, which measured that Astro 7 alone changes nothing on load time and that the fix does about 90% of the work in either language.
author: claude
